home.heroEyebrow: A smarter way to be discovered
home.heroSub: Create a detailed business profile on Pachankaun. Tell people what you offer, where you work, and what makes your business right for them.
home.heroNote: Start with a free account. Add your business profile next.
home.previewSub: Help people understand what you offer
home.previewBusinessSub: Matched to what someone is looking for
home.previewNote: Illustrative preview. Recommendations depend on the platform's features and available data.
home.stepsTitle: From local business to discoverable profile
home.stepsSub: A few clear steps help people understand your business and what you offer.
home.step1Desc: Sign up for Pachankaun to get started with your business profile.
home.step2Desc: Choose your business category and add the details that matter for your customers.
home.step3Desc: Your profile details can help power more relevant business recommendations as discovery features grow.
home.discoveryTitle: The right details help the right people find you
home.discoverySub: Your business profile gives Pachankaun useful context about what you do and who you serve. Those details can help improve recommendations that connect people with businesses suited to their needs.
home.profileDetail1: Choose a category and describe your products or services in your own words.
home.profileDetail2: Add your service area, contact details, and information relevant to your category.
home.profileDetail3: Keep your details current so customers—and future discovery tools—can understand your business.
home.finalTitle: Make your business easier to discover
home.finalSub: Create your Pachankaun account, then add a profile that tells people what makes your business a good fit.
home.retDesc: Crushed-rock manufactured sand for concrete and plastering.
home.gittiDesc: Crushed stone in 6–40 mm grades for concrete, foundations and roads.
home.bothDesc: Crusher dust for filling and bedding; GSB for road sub-base.
home.why1Desc: Material comes straight from our own crushing plant in Suwasra — no middleman.
home.why2Desc: Available sizes and grades are told clearly on the phone, so you order the right material.
home.why3Desc: Every load is written down with date and rate, so bills are never in dispute.
home.contactSub: Call or WhatsApp for rates, grades and bulk enquiries. Material is collected at the plant.

site.waDefault: Hello, I want to enquire about material (gitti / M-sand / stone dust / GSB).
site.aggDesc: Crushed stone aggregate in 6, 10, 12, 20 and 40 mm grades, plus other grades on request — for concrete, foundations and road work.
site.msandDesc: Manufactured sand from crushed rock — a consistent, locally made alternative to river sand for concrete and plastering.
site.dustDesc: Crusher dust for filling, base layers, paver bedding and mixing work.
site.gsbDesc: Granular sub-base material for road and hardstanding construction.
site.sizesNote: Sizes listed are as reported by the plant — confirm the grade you need when you call.
site.quote1: Material and size (for example: 20 mm gitti)
site.quote3: Your site or collection point (village / town)
site.collectionDesc: Material is collected at the plant in Suwasra — buyers arrange their own transport. Loading is done at the plant. Call to confirm loading timings for your trip.
site.plantSub: A working stone-crushing plant in Suwasra, Mandsaur district, Madhya Pradesh.
site.plantGalleryNote: These are representative images of aggregate material — photographs of our own plant are arriving shortly.
site.plantStep1: Rock is fed into the crusher
site.plantStep2: Crushing and screening into graded sizes
site.plantStep3: Stockpiled by grade, loaded at the plant
site.areaSub: The plant is at Suwasra, Mandsaur district, Madhya Pradesh. Material is collected at the plant — buyers arrange transport, so our buyers come from Suwasra and the surrounding towns and villages.
site.areaNote: Buying from further away? Call and tell us your location — collection is arranged directly with the plant.
site.contactSub: Call or WhatsApp the plant directly. Rates are told on the phone — they change, so we do not publish them here.
site.formNote: This opens WhatsApp with your enquiry ready to send — no account or sign-up needed.
site.formError: Please choose the material and enter a quantity.
site.footerNote: Aggregates, M-sand, stone dust and GSB — direct from the crusher at Suwasra.
aggUses: RCC and PCC concrete (20 mm, 40 mm)
Road work and base layers (6/10/12 mm)
Other grades — ask on the phone
site.msandSizes: One manufactured grade — confirm current grading and sieve details on the phone before ordering.
site.dustSizes: Sold as crusher dust (stone dust) — confirm gradation when you call.
site.gsbSizes: Supplied to road-work requirement — tell us your specification on the phone.
site.plantSlot3: Loading at the plant — photo coming
site.contactHoursNote: Call to confirm current plant and loading timings.
